Make It Animated | React Native Animations

name: Make It Animated
summary: Gallery of React Native animation examples recreated from popular apps, each with source code, plus drop-in components.
description: A browsable collection of React Native animations recreated from real app interactions (TikTok feed, Telegram profile header, Apple Wallet hold-near-reader, Reddit pull-to-refresh, Shopify tabs, Discord button shimmer, Raycast home search and more), with the code behind each example. Also lists drop-in React Native components, each built around a single animation pattern with compound APIs and full customization, using Reanimated, Gesture Handler, the Animated API and Skia. Most pages are JavaScript-rendered, so the homepage and pricing text were not readable.
contains: recreates interactions from TikTok, Telegram, Apple Wallet, Reddit, Shopify, Discord, Slack and more
drop-in React Native components with compound APIs
covers tabs, navbar, carousel, button, scroll, switch, background, loader, card, 3D, drawer and input patterns
